title: Removal Orders, Removal Fees and Disposal Fees under FBN
content:
A removal order is the seller's own instruction to return or dispose of their inventory and is placed and confirmed by the seller; it can be cancelled only while its status is the removal order cancellation status of the program. A removal order may not request more units of a SKU than that SKU's units on hand. Removal and disposal fees are billed per unit when the units leave inventory, at the fee class of the SKU's size tier through the removal fee size class map and the program in force on that date. Removal fees may be billed only while the enrollment is active, inbound suspended or winding down.

These terms apply to inventory held in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN).

## Units on hand of a SKU

A SKU's units on hand are all units of that SKU that came into the enrollment's inventory (inbound receipts, found units, restocked returns) less all units that left it (outbound shipments, removals and disposals, lost or damaged write-offs), counted from activation to the handling date inclusive.

| Units on hand of the SKU (hypothetical) | Units requested on the removal order | Allowed |
|---|---|---|
| 120 | 120 | yes |
| 120 | 121 | no |

## The fees

- **Removal (return to seller):** the units multiplied by the removal fee of the SKU's removal class (small standard, large standard or oversize), rounded to the cent.
- **Disposal:** the units multiplied by the disposal fee of the SKU's disposal class (standard for small standard and large standard tiers, oversize otherwise), rounded to the cent.
- The fee is billed when the units leave inventory, at the program in force on that date.

## The enrollment-status condition for removal fees

Whether a removal fee may be billed is read from the system record of the enrollment the removal order belongs to — its current status — and not from the seller's description of it.

| Enrollment status on the system record | Removal fee may be billed |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| inbound suspended | yes |
| winding down | yes |
| pending | no |
| closed | no |
